headline_seed: Whistleblower warns Postal Service's new mail ballot system has "potentially catastrophic problems" - CBS News
draft_text:
A federal whistleblower says USPS's new mail ballot system rejects entire batches if one barcode fails to scan. NPR and NBC News report the disclosure — filed via Whistleblower Aid — warns thousands of ballots could face repeated delays.

And that's the mews.
